verified_facts.text: The St. Regis Toronto is the country's first St. Regis hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: As Canada’s luxury hotel with the largest suite collection and the country’s first St. Regis hotel

verified_facts.text: Before becoming a St. Regis, the hotel was a Trump property and then The Adelaide.
verified_facts.excerpt: first as a Trump property, then as The Adelaide, and now as Canada’s first St. Regis

verified_facts.text: LOUIX LOUIS restaurant sits 31 floors above the Toronto skyline.
verified_facts.excerpt: LOUIX LOUIS soars 31 floors above the Toronto skyline

verified_facts.text: LOUIX LOUIS's interior is designed to represent the inside of a crystal whiskey glass, inspired by Toronto's distilling heritage.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by Toronto’s heritage as one of the largest distillery districts in the world during the turn of the 19th century, the dramatic interior is designed to represent the inside of a glistening crystal whiskey glass

verified_facts.text: At the heart of LOUIX LOUIS is a two-story grand bar showcasing over 500 dark spirits.
verified_facts.excerpt: At the heart of the restaurant is the glamorous two-story high grand bar showcasing over 500 dark spirits.

verified_facts.text: LOUIX LOUIS serves American cuisine with a French twist.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy American cuisine with a French twist, signature cocktails, and extensive wine and dark spirit offerings, all with panoramic views of Toronto.

verified_facts.text: The hotel holds a champagne sabering ritual at 6:00 pm seven days a week in the lobby-level Astor Lounge.
verified_facts.excerpt: The St. Regis Toronto hosts this signature ritual at 6:00 pm in Astor Lounge seven days a week, located lobby-level

verified_facts.text: The hotel's take on the Bloody Mary is called the Rouge 140 and is served at LOUIX LOUIS.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our version of the classic Bloody Mary, named the 'Rouge 140', is available at LOUIX LOUIS grand bar and restaurant

verified_facts.text: Afternoon tea features a bespoke blend called Midnight Blossom made for the hotel by Toronto-based Sloane Fine Tea Merchants.
verified_facts.excerpt: we are proud to work with Toronto-based Sloane Fine Tea Merchants who has curated an impeccable selection of fine teas including a bespoke blend made for The St. Regis Toronto, named Midnight Blossom

verified_facts.text: The spa is on the 31st floor.
verified_facts.excerpt: Unwind at The St. Regis Spa Toronto, our 31st-floor sanctuary in the sky

verified_facts.text: The spa is 15,000 square feet with a fitness centre and an infinity pool overlooking the city skyline.
verified_facts.excerpt: the 15,000-square-foot spa hotel near downtown Toronto is an urban oasis that invites guests to renew and recharge with ultra-luxurious amenities, a fitness centre, and an infinity pool overlooking the glittering city skyline

verified_facts.text: An infinity-edge lap pool and whirlpool are on the hotel's 32nd floor, with a dry sauna and steam room.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relax even further at our infinity-edge lap pool and whirlpool on the hotel's 32nd floor, or in our detoxifying dry sauna and steam room.

verified_facts.text: Rooms start at 550 square feet.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our hotel also boasts 258 of the largest luxury accommodation in downtown Toronto, Canada, which start at 550 square feet.

verified_facts.text: Every room and suite has a European-style wet bar and a Nespresso beverage system.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy a European-style wet bar, free Wi-Fi and a Nespresso® beverage system in every room and suite

verified_facts.text: Bathrooms have a rainfall shower, deep-soaking tub and in-mirror TV.
verified_facts.excerpt: Find a rainfall shower, deep-soaking tub and in-mirror TV in your hotel room's spacious bathroom

verified_facts.text: The Caroline Astor and John Jacob Astor suites are on the 30th floor, each with a kitchen, living and dining room, 2 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Caroline Astor and John Jacob Astor suites are located on the 30th floor of the hotel showcasing 1,675 and 2,035 square feet of stunning space including a kitchen, living and dining room, 2 bedrooms, and 2.5 bathrooms.

verified_facts.text: All rooms come with St. Regis butler service.
verified_facts.excerpt: There's free WiFi, and all rooms come with St. Regis butler service.

verified_facts.text: Family experiences include a movie and popcorn night, an in-room Wilderness Retreat and Mrs Astor's Little Tea society.
verified_facts.excerpt: Entertain every age with a movie and popcorn night, cozy up with our in-room Wilderness Retreat or delight little ones with Mrs Astor's Little Tea society.

verified_facts.text: The CF Toronto Eaton Centre is two blocks from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Just two blocks away from The St. Regis Toronto, the CF Toronto Eaton Centre is the city’s most famous retail destination

verified_facts.text: Nathan Phillips Square is two blocks from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located in the heart of the City and just two blocks from The St. Regis Toronto, no trip to Toronto is complete without a photo with the ‘TORONTO’ sign at Nathan Phillips Square.

verified_facts.text: Billy Bishop Toronto City Airport is about 3 km from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: The closest airport near The St. Regis Toronto is Billy Bishop Toronto City Airport (YTZ). YTZ is located approximately 3.0 KM from the hotel.

verified_facts.text: The hotel does not provide an airport shuttle service.
verified_facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

verified_facts.text: Pets are welcome for a non-refundable fee per stay.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, pets are welcome at The St. Regis Toronto. A non-refundable pet fee of $150.00 per stay applies.

verified_facts.text: Self parking and valet parking are each $70 per day.
verified_facts.excerpt: Self parking is available for $70.00 per day. Valet parking is available for $70.00 per day.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers a private Niagara Falls tour in a luxury SUV with a licensed guide.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy a private Niagara Falls tour in a luxury SUV with a licensed guide.

verified_facts.text: The Spa was named a Forbes Five Star Spa in 2023 and 2024.
verified_facts.excerpt: 2023 & 2024 Forbes Five Star Spa

verified_facts.text: The hotel received a 2025 Forbes Travel Guide Five Star Award.
verified_facts.excerpt: 2025 Forbes Travel Guide Five Star Award

verified_facts.text: The editorial review describes a zero-edge saltwater lap pool surrounded by city views.
verified_facts.excerpt: a zero-edge saltwater lap pool surrounded by city views
